evals.prompt: I'm a first-time non-technical founder and don't know AWS pricing or architecture well. Audit this offline resource snapshot for us at Pre-Revenue MVP stage right now, and also explain what changes once we hit Series A / SOC 2: 2 unattached Elastic IPs, 300 GB of unattached `gp2` EBS volumes, 1 stopped EC2 instance with a 200 GB `gp3` volume attached for 30 days, 500 GB of CloudWatch Log Groups set to `Never Expire`, 1 idle `ml.g5.xlarge` SageMaker Notebook `InService` 24/7 (~$1.006/hr), 2 NAT Gateways with zero VPC Gateway Endpoints in a VPC pushing 400 GB/mo to S3 and DynamoDB, and 1 production `db.t4g.medium` RDS PostgreSQL instance with `StorageEncrypted=true` and `MultiAZ=false`.
evals.expected_output: Applies the 26-point stage-calibrated audit formulas to quantify monthly waste across `COST-01` (`200 * $0.08 = $16.00/mo`), `COST-02` (`2 * $3.65 = $7.30/mo`), `COST-03` (`300 * $0.10 = $30.00/mo` + `gp2` -> `gp3` note), `COST-05` (`500 * $0.03 = $15.00/mo` compounding), `COST-06` (`$1.006 * 730 = ~$734.38/mo`), and `COST-07` (`2 * $32.85 = $65.70/mo` fixed + `400 * $0.045 = $18.00/mo` = `$83.70/mo`, recommending free S3/DynamoDB Gateway Endpoints and `fck-nat` `t4g.nano` ~$3/mo for MVP), and contrasts `SCALE-04` (`MultiAZ=False` PASS at Pre-Revenue MVP saving ~50% DB cost vs `MultiAZ=True` FAIL/required at Series A / SOC 2).
expectations: Activates the `startup-account-audit` skill and accurately calculates monthly waste across `COST-01` ($16/mo stopped EC2 gp3), `COST-02` ($7.30/mo unattached EIPs), `COST-03` ($30/mo unattached gp2 EBS), `COST-05` ($15/mo infinite CloudWatch Logs), `COST-06` (~$734/mo idle `InService` SageMaker notebook), and `COST-07` ($65.70/mo fixed NAT Gateways + $18/mo data processing).
Recommends free S3 and DynamoDB VPC Gateway Endpoints (`com.amazonaws.<region>.s3` / `dynamodb`) plus evaluating `fck-nat` (`t4g.nano` ~$3/mo) at Pre-Revenue MVP stage.

Explains `SCALE-04` stage calibration clearly: `MultiAZ=False` on `db.t4g.medium` is appropriate at Pre-Revenue MVP to save ~50% RDS cost, whereas Series A+ / SOC 2 requires enabling `MultiAZ=True` for production high availability.
